title: World Championship Decks 1999: card flavor text

entities.name: Greven il-Vec
entities.description: Commander who threatens Gerrard and punishes Vhati.

entities.name: Vhati il-Dal
entities.description: Subordinate lifted off his feet by Greven.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Father of Machines who began the Grand Evolution.

entities.name: Radiant
entities.description: Archangel who lost her finest warrior to the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Selenia
entities.description: Lady Selenia, Radiant's finest warrior lost to the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Shauku
entities.description: Endbringer who writes with students' blood.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's brother whose strategy was to deny Argoth to all.

entities.name: Gatha
entities.description: Tolarian renegade who survived by appeasing Keld's predators.

entities.name: Stromgald Cabal
entities.description: Cabal whose agents fuel rituals with their own flesh.

entities.name: Metathran
entities.description: Children of Urza made by machines.

entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: Land Mishra would deny to others.

entities.name: Shiv
entities.description: Land hatched from stone around a flame yolk.

events.summary: Greven lifts Vhati off his feet and punishes his failure with a fall.
events.quote: The fall will give you time to think on your failure.

events.summary: Radiant prays Lady Selenia died honorably after losing her to the Phyrexians.
events.quote: My finest warrior was lost to the Phyrexians.
I will flay the skin from your flesh and the flesh from your bones and scrape your bones dry.

events.summary: Urza's metathran children are produced by integrated machines.
events.quote: Urza's metathran children were conceived, birthed, and nurtured by an integrated system of machines.

events.summary: Mishra's helix reflects his strategy to deny Argoth to all.
events.quote: if he couldn't have Argoth, no one could.

events.summary: Tahngarth advises looking at your feet while trampling an enemy.
events.quote: Look at your feet while you trample him.

events.summary: Gamelen proclaims the first seedling of Argoth sprouted here and the last tree will fall here.
events.quote: Here the last tree will fall.

relations.note: Allied Balduvia and Kjeldor deprived Stromgald of victories.
relations.quote: the alliance between Balduvia and Kjeldor
